svg.title: Ishikari metro map, readable
svg.text: Read it like a page: each row left to right, then wrap to the next row.
a plan may run a saved workflow in place of a worker ant
bugs: the detective's fix plan goes back to the worker;
the worker builds it, the detective re-checks; 3 tries per bug
fail: tasks clash: the task takes
them in, then the fix loop; 2 rounds
7+, or no gaps: no fix round
below 7 and gaps: one fix round
a failed fix keeps its branch;

g.title: Task: The work you hand Ishikari. Click for more.
Investigator ant: Asks you questions, then writes the investigation report. Click for more.
g.text: one live agent run by the skill: reads
the repo once, gets each answer as a message;
no Agent tool: the plan workflow runs it

g.title: You: You answer the investigator's questions. Click for more.
g.text: 8 in all; answering approves the whole run

g.title: Researcher ants: Look up facts for the investigator. Click for more.
g.text: up to 5 at once, web + computer,

g.title: investigation_report.md: Everything learned while planning, written once. Click for more.
Add requirement ant: Drafts the requirement entry; skipped with no requirements file. Click for more.
g.text: the main session pipes it into ishikari.py req add;
no requirements file: no add requirement ant

g.title: Architect ant: Writes architecture.md and one plan per task. Click for more.
Worker plans: One complete plan per task. Click for more.
g.text: one per task: title, files, after;

g.title: Logbook: Every ant's reply, one entry each. Click for more.
g.text: logbook clerk ant: appends each ant's entry
the moment the ant replies, one clerk at a time, in plan, build and finish.
The live investigator gets only an investigated entry.
Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it.

g.title: Worker ants: Build the plans, one worktree each. Click for more.
Detective ants: Check each built task and plan every fix. Click for more.
g.text: one per built task: checks it against plan +
design, runs tests (reuses the worker's if clean);
finds each bug's cause and plans its fix

g.title: Integrator ant: Merges all passing tasks in a scratch copy and tests once. Click for more.
g.text: merges passing tasks in a scratch
copy, tests once: the combined test;
fewer than 2 passing tasks: no combined test

g.title: Dropped: A task that could not be fixed. Click for more.
g.text: after 3 tries on a bug or

g.title: Merger ant: Merges the approved tasks for real, then checks with git. Click for more.
g.text: merges in a straight line in a scratch copy,
or reuses build's trial merge; then checks
its own merge with git cherry

g.title: merge failed: Back to the worker ant on the task's own branch. Click for more.
g.text: a conflict, failed tests, or missing in git:
the worker ant merges main, fixes it,
detective re-checks; max 2 extra build rounds

g.title: Janitor ant: Cleans up mess the run left, by itself. Click for more.
g.text: cleans up dead code and mess itself: edits,
runs the tests, commits, lands it only if
they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines;
a cleanup run has no janitor

g.title: Dropped cleanup: A cleanup whose tests failed. Click for more.
g.text: its note offered as the next Task

g.title: Juror ants: Score each merged task against its plan. Click for more.
g.text: one per merged task, 5 at once;

g.title: Judge ant: Scores the whole run 0-10 against the plans. Click for more.
g.text: scores the run 0-10: does the code
match the plans? its own call, not an average

g.title: Worker ant: Closes the judge's gaps. Click for more.
Detective ant: Checks the judge fix. Click for more.
g.text: checks the fix, runs the tests

g.title: Merger ant: Lands the judge fix by fast-forward. Click for more.
g.text: fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix;
the fix lands only through this fast-forward

g.title: Judge ant: Scores again after the fix. Click for more.
Finisher ant: Moves main, cleans up, runs the check. Click for more.
g.text: appends the stage rows, runs the check

g.title: MAIN: Your main branch, moved forward. Click for more.
checkCommand: Builds and checks the app after main moves. Click for more.
g.text: the finisher ant builds and checks the app,
only when main moved and checkCommand is set

g.title: check-fix round: A failed check: one build round. Click for more.
g.text: a failed check: one build round

g.title: req done: Marks this run's requirements DONE. Click for more.
g.text: the main session marks the kept :ID:s
once the check passed, or there is none

svg.text: a bug through the fix loop
